MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The four-port USB hub fits my keyboard, card reader, and other accessories by making them easier to connect to my computer.",
    "Spare microSD cards fit my Raspberry Pi projects, while the surge protector supports the desk organization reflected in my cable-management purchases."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo devices introduce voice-assistant, car, and smart-display uses that do not follow from my current computer and accessory needs.",
    "The large internal SSD and portable speaker address needs I have not expressed: a major storage upgrade and listening away from headphones.",
    "The HDMI cable is relevant but duplicates something I already have, and the ten-port hub exceeds the connectivity I currently need."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying electronics seems to have been treated as interest in other electronic devices, even when they serve unrelated purposes.",
    "My purchases of storage and audio accessories seem to have been stretched into interest in much larger storage and a different way of listening."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My recent purchases emphasize practical improvements to connecting, organizing, and maintaining my computer setup.",
    "What I already own matters: another HDMI cable adds little right now, whereas spare microSD cards could support additional Raspberry Pi projects.",
    "The size of the solution matters to me: a compact four-port hub fits my current needs better than a ten-port powered hub."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my interest in practical setup accessories but extended it too broadly to unrelated devices and upgrades I do not currently need."
}
